notes: 20 modules: fit + fight per stage across 10 stages. APPLIES THE ARCADE SESSION STANDARD (specs/27, data/arcade-session-standards.json). Restructured from 12 stages to 10 so the campaign completes inside the Arcade 10-stage ladder: the old S10 "Arena’s Strongest" folded into S08 (Jack) and the old S11 "Strongest Teen" folded into S09 (Pickle); the Ogre moved from S12 to S10. Tier map: T1 stages 1-3, T2 4-5, T3 6-7, T4 8-10 — back-loaded so the peak stages carry the T4 volume. FIT modules carry a counted `prescription` (sets x reps/sec + category + tier); stored numbers are the NORMAL baseline, the app re-resolves easy/hard from the volume ladder by tier+category. FIGHT modules carry a `canonical_map` (thematic drill -> canonical discipline + move) and a `finishers` block (explosive bodyweight between/after rounds, capped, counting toward the plyo cap). SAFETY: karate/kung-fu striking uses a bag with proper alignment, never bare-knuckle makiwara boards; the Jack stage is normal heavy strength (no PEDs); fantasy feats are lore only. Split stages 4-9 are SKILL-FIRST.

both_rules.description: When a stage is run as BOTH (fit + fight combined).
both_rules.sequencing: Skill/fight first while fresh, then fit. Stages 4-9 are already skill-first split (fight = AM, fit = PM); stages 1-3 and 10 are single-session, so BOTH runs fight -> fit back-to-back.
both_rules.shared_plyo_cap: The campaign plyo foot-contact cap is counted ACROSS the whole session — fight finishers + fit explosive share it; if combined would exceed it, the fit explosive block trims first.
both_rules.volume_sanity: In a single-session BOTH (stages 1-3, 10), fit accessory volume may drop one notch so two full high-volume blocks aren’t stacked.
both_rules.readiness: A BOTH day is a HARD day: readiness gate applies before starting, and it won't schedule back-to-back with another hard day.
both_rules.announcer: States the combined plan up front (e.g. 'Stage 4: Katsumi. Fight — 5 rounds. Then Fit — Power Base, 4 workouts.').
